exercise.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
library_steps: Clip on the safety key and start walking with the belt flat.
Raise the incline step by step, then hold a steady brisk pace.
Keep your hands off the rails and lower the incline before stopping.
exercise.one_line_summary: Brisk walk on a treadmill belt rising ~10 deg, trunk leaning into the hill, hands off the rails. Picture 1: left foot forward flat on the slope, right foot pushing off behind; picture 2: the other way round.

setup.target: Lean ~8 deg into the slope, hands off the rails.

movement.measure: knee bend at heel contact / flat foot

movement.start: heel up on the ball of the foot

muscles.emg: Gluteus maximus x3.5 at 9 deg uphill vs level (S1).
muscles.role: Library primary 'cardio' has no mask; the slope makes the hip extensors the main movers, so glutes are primary here.
x3.7 uphill (S1); kept unlit so the picture shows the hip-driven climb.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Hands on the rails and leaning back.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Cuts the work of the climb (S2).

sources.citation: Franz JR, Kram R. The effects of grade and speed on leg muscle activations during walking. Gait Posture. 2012;35(1):143-147.
sources.what_it_gave: Walking uphill at 9 deg: biceps femoris x6.4, gluteus maximus x3.5, vastus medialis x3.7 and medial gastrocnemius x1.75 compared with level walking.

sources.citation: Lay AN, Hass CJ, Richard Nichols T, Gregor RJ. The effects of sloped surfaces on locomotion: an electromyographic analysis. J Biomech. 2007;40(6):1276-1285.
sources.what_it_gave: Uphill walking raises hip and knee extensor and plantarflexor activity; trunk leans into the slope.

sources.citation: Meyns P, Bruijn SM, Duysens J. The how and why of arm swing during human walking. Gait Posture. 2013;38(4):555-562.
sources.what_it_gave: Arms swing opposite to the legs in walking and running.

clip_check.check: front leg: knee bend at heel contact / flat foot

clip_check.target: heel up on the ball of the foot -> (other leg) (10-25 deg)

clip_check.check: Machine parts meet the hands/feet; levers keep their length
clip_check.target: moving rod lengths equal at start and end (+-1 cm)
